item.description: New research examines how the Indian River County school district is working to reverse enrollment declines as school choice options expand across Florida.

item.title: Karolina Muchova ends Coco Gauff's Wimbledon run in dramatic tiebreaker
item.description: Karolina Muchova ended Coco Gauff's run at Wimbledon with a 6-2, 1-6, 7-6 (10) victory Thursday that ended with a drama-filled tiebreaker.

item.title: Florida's 32-day back-to-school sales tax holiday begins July 20
item.description: Families can save hundreds of dollars during the state's annual tax-free shopping period running from July 20 through Aug. 20, covering clothing, school supplies, computers and learning aids.

item.title: Port St. Lucie's 6,000-seat soccer stadium groundbreaking planned for November
item.description: Port St. Lucie SC released new renderings of its 6,000-seat stadium and announced groundbreaking is anticipated for November. The stadium will be built at the Walton & One development along U.S. 1 and Walton Road.
